findings.description: The agent is only allowed Read/Grep/Glob/Write, but implement-discipline grading depends on observing source edits as well as new test writes. The transcript extractor records Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit, yet those tools are not actually permitted in the Claude invocation, so any fixture requiring modification of existing source/test files will fail at execution time or force the model into overwriting files with Write instead of editing normally.
findings.failure_mode: Implement-discipline trials can fail before reaching graders, or produce incomplete/unnatural write traces, because the executor blocks the edit tools needed for ordinary implementation tasks.
findings.suggested_fix: Include the edit tools in --allowed-tools, e.g. Read,Grep,Glob,Write,Edit,MultiEdit,NotebookEdit, matching the extractor below.
